items.description: Inspired by the works of T.E. Lawrence, enter the world of the ARAB REVOLT. Fight and survive the Turkish attack on Yenbo of 1916, trek the uninhabitable expanse of the Sinai deserts, search for and destroy the railways of the Hejaz and fight alongside the soldiers of the revolt to launch the climactic 1917 Battle of Akaba. REVOLT 1917 is an indie first person shooter set in the World War I Middle East. Blending survival and military shooter elements into several vast locales, REVOLT 1917 features gameplay elements such as:A MULTI-CHAPTER SINGLEPLAYER DESERT CAMPAIGN-Follow in the footsteps of the Arab tribal leaders as you explore the history and lands of the Arab Revolt. Play over multiple key locations in the events of the time with each chapter promising a new gameplay focus.A FULLY DYNAMIC DAY/NIGHT/WEATHER/TEMPERATURE SYSTEM-Plan expeditions carefully to not fall victim to the perils of extreme desert heat or an unsuspecting sandstorm.AN IN DEPTH TIME AND CALENDAR SYSTEM-Launch attacks with hourly precision utilizing a full 24 hour time cycle and time sensitive objectives. LARGE 2 SQ. KILOMETER ENVIRONMENTS-Locales include city interiors, small desert villages scattered across desert dunes, narrow rocky canyons and coastal ports; each forcing a differing play style.A COMPLEX HEALTH/STAMINA/HYDRATION SURVIVAL SYSTEM-Simple on the surface; complex behind the scenes. Every degree of temperature, second spent sprinting through the heat, varying time of day, etc. will affect the player's characteristics. As you fall to dehydration and exhaustion your vision will blur and your agility will diminish.**For best results do not play on integrated graphics** Subscribe to our newsletter Get STEAM deals and FREE games in your inbox Game developers Want your game sold on DailyIndieGame? items.description: Ride through a forgotten South, where revolvers clash with revolution. This is not the American West—this is post-unification Southern Italy, where fading nobles, ex-priests, bandits, and bounty hunters fight for power in a land torn between history and myth. In this Spaghetti Western-inspired narrative action game, you'll take on the role of Veronica, a Russian noblewoman who runs a casino in Naples and moonlights as a bounty hunter. Alongside her eccentric gang—including a pleasure-loving priest, a noble bored of wealth, and a seasoned brigand—you’ll choose contracts, face morally grey decisions, and uncover conspiracies that bind the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies to its ruins. 🎮 GAME FEATURES: 🔫 Cinematic Shootouts & Duels: Tactical third-person gunplay inspired by Spaghetti Western classics. 🎭 Multiple Playable Characters: Choose from Veronica, Aloisio the priest, Totonno the brigand, and Francesco the noble. 🌍 Historical-Fiction Setting: Explore stylized versions of Naples, Paestum, Salerno, and rural Southern villages reimagined as a lawless frontier. 🐴 Open-ended Missions: Work for Italians, Borbonics, or play both sides—your loyalties are yours to sell. 🎵 Original Soundtrack blending Morricone-esque cues with Southern Italian folk. 🗺️ Rich Dialogue & Choices: Interact with rebels, clergy, aristocrats, and outlaws through branching dialogue trees. 💥 Mini-games & Side Activities: From casino dancing to cannon testing, every location has its secrets. Wishlist the full game now and saddle up for the revolution of the South. Wishlist now and prepare for a frontier where the bullets sing in dialect and every truth wears a mask.
